graph_export_caveat: The explicit graph exporter contains guarded metadata/rank/axis repairs for legacy ONNX lowering of dynamic stack/rotary/endpoint-difference shapes. Original learned modules remain unchanged; independent re-export hashes, full upstream-method comparisons, dynamic batch/candidate cases and invalid-coordinate probes passed. public_surfaces: Existing BoundaryPipeline and AutoPipeline extract_json variants use source-faithful single-instance legacy decoding.
Additive extract_with_records and extract_json_with_records accept a typed RecordMetadata sidecar; existing public schema fields are unchanged.
Natural, latent and anchorless record modes preserve ragged field-major candidate/seed semantics and source decoding/cardinality/exclusivity rules.
Span architecture explicitly rejects the new record-sidecar methods; existing v2 methods remain unchanged.
Structure/entity/classification schemas share a single encoder invocation with validated global query routing.
Choice-prefix values use the separate learned explicit scorer, not the shared-pool scorer. Literal ownership and Unicode matching follow pinned Python behavior.
